open_empty_folder.reachable_control: configuration panel always renders open_map_configs_folder button
open_empty_folder.finding: The command resolves and opens data/user/map-configs without creating it; a fresh profile can invoke it while the directory is absent.
open_empty_folder.proposed_correction: Create the isolated map-config directory before launching the platform file manager.

truncating_config_write.finding: write_map_config truncates the destination in place, so a process kill during the write can leave invalid JSON.
truncating_config_write.proposed_correction: Route the already serialized JSON bytes through existing write_bytes_atomic; retain filename validation and payload bytes.
